notes.sowing: Start indoors 4 to 6 weeks before planting out, or sow {cm:1} deep outdoors. Set plants out 2 to 4 weeks before your last frost. For a fall crop, sow 10 to 12 weeks before your first fall frost.
notes.care: Kale grows best in cool weather; in heat above about {c:24} the leaves turn tough and bitter. Mulch to keep the roots cool and water in dry spells. Avoid ground where cabbage-family crops grew in recent years.
notes.harvest: Pick the lowest two or three leaves per plant at a time and leave the crown growing. Frost sweetens the leaves, and plants keep cropping well past the first fall frosts.
